title: Establishing Trustworthiness: Rethinking Tasks and Model Evaluation
reasoning: The paper primarily discusses 'trustworthiness' in the context of AI reliability, transparency, and model understanding (functional capacity and data origin). While it touches on 'user trust' in high-stakes scenarios, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as intrinsic properties or primary evaluation components of the LLMs themselves. The 'trust' discussed is technical and epistemic, not ethical or spiritual.
